$comment: Allowlist for the E2E test duration flagger (e2e-durations.go, threshold 2s, warn-only). Key format: `<spec file>::<describe chain joined with ’ › ’>::<test title>`. A value is either a bare reason string (legacy: suppressed at any duration over 2s) or an object `{ "maxMs": N, "reason": "..." }` that raises this test’s budget to N ms (suppressed at or under N, warns again past N). Per-platform sections because Linux Docker and macOS speeds differ. Every entry needs a reason; adding an entry, raising a cap, or keeping a newly-slow test needs David’s OK. Dead entries (test gone) are auto-removed on local E2E runs; entries whose test drops well under 2s are reported for review.
